editor_note: Entry 19 (the Propagated noise absorption card) attaches "has absorbed noise model information" to the wrong noun. The Korean says the expectation values absorbed the noise-model information, but the English says the target observable did. That is how PNA works, so a learner would come away with the wrong idea of the technique. The rewritten entries 14-16 also switch "noise" to 잡음 (잡음 모델, 양자 잡음 특성화), while the rest of the page, including entries 17-19 and 25, uses 노이즈. The same "Browse documentation" link is also rendered three ways: 문서 찾아보기 (entry 16), 문서 살펴보기 (entry 19) and 문서 보기 (entry 24).

examples.source: Mitigate expectation values by measuring a target observable that has absorbed noise model information.
examples.translation: 타겟 관측량(observable)을 측정하여 노이즈 모델 정보를 흡수한 기댓값을 완화합니다.
examples.suggested: 노이즈 모델 정보를 흡수한 타겟 관측량을 측정하여 기댓값을 완화합니다.
examples.why: The relative clause should describe the observable, but in the Korean it modifies 기댓값. That misstates the PNA mechanism, in which the observable is modified to absorb the noise model.

examples.source: Build randomization-based quantum noise characterization experiments ...
examples.translation: 무작위화 기반 양자 잡음 특성화 실험과 모델 피팅 분석 파이프라인을 구축합니다
examples.suggested: 무작위화 기반 양자 노이즈 특성화 실험과 모델 피팅 분석 파이프라인을 구축합니다
examples.why: Entries 14-16 use 잡음 while entries 17-19, 23, 25 and 26 use 노이즈. The same term is rendered inconsistently across adjacent sections.

examples.source: linkText="Browse documentation"
examples.translation: linkText="문서 살펴보기"
examples.suggested: 문서 보기
examples.why: The same link label appears as 문서 보기, 문서 찾아보기 and 문서 살펴보기 across the page's cards. It should use one form throughout.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and no entry would mislead a learner. The page uses formal 하십시오체 (있습니다, 입니다, 도와줍니다, 됩니다) instead of the project's 해요체 convention, which is a register slip. In [3], 'reusable set of instructions' is rendered as '명령어 세트', which suggests commands or opcodes. '지침 모음' is closer to prompt-style instructions and matches '지침' in [5].

examples.source: Skills can help save time and ensure that repeatable tasks are done consistently and correctly.
examples.translation: 스킬은 시간을 절약하고 반복적인 작업이 일관되고 정확하게 수행되도록 도와줍니다.
examples.suggested: 스킬을 쓰면 시간을 아끼고, 반복 작업을 일관되고 정확하게 처리할 수 있어요.
examples.why: The whole page uses 하십시오체, but the project convention is 해요체.

examples.source: An AI skill is a reusable set of instructions that teaches the assistant how to complete a specific task.
examples.translation: AI 스킬이란 특정 작업을 완료하는 방법을 어시스턴트에게 알려주는 재사용 가능한 명령어 세트입니다.
examples.suggested: AI 스킬은 어시스턴트에게 특정 작업을 수행하는 방법을 알려 주는 재사용 가능한 지침 모음이에요.
examples.why: '명령어' reads as commands or CLI instructions. 'Instructions' here means natural-language guidance, which is rendered as '지침' in [5].

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful: [10] keeps the conditional 'R_Z rotation depending on the measurement outcome' (측정 결과에 따라 $R_Z$ 회전을 적용), and [17] preserves the parenthetical justification (두 qubit Gate가 단일 qubit Gate보다 훨씬 오류가 많기 때문에), the before/after cancellation, and 결맞음 오류(coherent error)→확률적 오류 without drift.

The 12 rewritten entries keep their meaning: the enable flags, the default "XX" sequence, the U U† U factor of 3, the PEA/PEC noise-learning notes and the max_overhead caveat all match the English. Entry 10 has two small problems. It renders "coherent errors" as "일관성 오류", which reads as "consistency error". The usual Korean terms are "코히어런트 오류" or "결맞는 오류". This matches the file's existing "일관성 노이즈" in entry 18, so it's an imperfect but consistent term, not a false concept. Entry 10 also drops "and run": the pulses are only said to be scheduled at precise intervals, not also run at them.

examples.source: unwanted interactions between qubits can lead to coherent errors on idling qubits
examples.translation: qubit 간의 원치 않는 상호 작용으로 인해 유휴 Qubit에 일관성 오류가 발생할 수 있습니다
examples.suggested: qubit 간의 원치 않는 상호 작용으로 인해 유휴 Qubit에 코히어런트(결맞는) 오류가 발생할 수 있습니다
examples.why: '일관성' means consistency. In error terminology, 'coherent' means systematic and unitary, and it is normally rendered 코히어런트 or 결맞는. The meaning is recognizable but imprecise.

examples.source: sequences of microwave pulses that need to be scheduled and run at precise time intervals
examples.translation: 이 펄스들은 정밀한 시간 간격에 맞춰 스케줄링되어야 합니다
examples.suggested: 이 펄스들은 정밀한 시간 간격에 맞춰 스케줄링되고 실행되어야 합니다
examples.why: The translation drops 'and run', so it keeps only the scheduling requirement. The loss is minor and does not mislead.

editor_note: Entry 15 says the same thing as the English. Exclusive access, the calibration-jobs exclusion, parallelism in the stack, avoiding per-job queuing delay and the cost function running on the local machine are all kept, and nothing is added. The one problem is how "dedicated window" is translated: "전용 창" and "이 창이 열려 있는 동안" copy the English literally, and 창 plus "열려 있는" makes a Korean reader picture a UI window rather than a block of time. Using "전용 시간 구간" / "이 시간 동안" would make it clear that a session is a reserved period of time. It does not change the meaning, since exclusive access makes the sense recoverable, so this is minor.

examples.source: A dedicated window for running a multi-job workload.  During this window, the user has exclusive access of the system
examples.translation: 다중 작업 워크로드를 실행하기 위한 전용 창입니다. 이 창이 열려 있는 동안 사용자는 시스템에 독점적으로 접근할 수 있으며
examples.suggested: 다중 작업 워크로드를 실행하기 위해 할당된 전용 시간 구간입니다. 이 시간 동안 사용자는 시스템에 독점적으로 접근할 수 있으며
examples.why: '창'/'창이 열려 있는 동안' copies the English 'window' word for word and makes a Korean reader think of a GUI window. What the source means is a reserved time slot.

editor_note: The three rewritten entries are faithful. "API documentation" becomes "API 문서", the init_qubits line "각 샷에 대해 Qubit을 기저 상태로 초기화할지 여부" keeps the per-shot reset to the ground state, and the Recommendations admonition's "API 문서를 검토하세요" uses 해요체 correctly.

Neither rewritten description misleads a reader. Entry 13 ("특정 관심 분야의 지식과 역량을 쌓을 수 있도록 … 체계적으로 엮은 학습 경로") is faithful and reads naturally. Two things still need changing. First, in entries 12 and 13 the visible title and linkText ("Learning", "Visit IBM Quantum Learning", "Learning paths", "Explore learning paths") were left in English, while the neighbouring cards in entries 10 and 11 translate them ("빠른 시작", "구성 시작하기", "튜토리얼 둘러보기"). Second, in entry 12, "full courses" became "전체 강좌", which reads as "all courses" rather than "complete, full-length courses".

examples.source: Explore our free learning offerings, such as full courses and classroom modules.
examples.translation: 전체 강좌와 클래스룸 모듈 등 무료 학습 콘텐츠를 살펴보세요.
examples.suggested: 정규 강좌와 수업용 모듈 등 무료 학습 콘텐츠를 살펴보세요.
examples.why: '전체 강좌' suggests the entire course catalogue rather than full-length courses. '클래스룸 모듈' is a loan-word calque; '수업용 모듈' is more natural.

examples.source: title="Learning" … linkText="Visit IBM Quantum Learning"
examples.translation: title="Learning" … linkText="Visit IBM Quantum Learning"
examples.suggested: title="학습" … linkText="IBM Quantum Learning 방문하기"
examples.why: The visible card title and link text were left in English, while the sibling cards in entries 10 and 11 translate theirs. This is inconsistent within one card group.

examples.source: title="Learning paths" … linkText="Explore learning paths"
examples.translation: title="Learning paths" … linkText="Explore learning paths"
examples.suggested: title="학습 경로" … linkText="학습 경로 살펴보기"
examples.why: The description already says '학습 경로', but the title and link text on the same card stay in English, unlike entries 10 and 11.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. That covers the "only works with" constraints in [10] and [35], the deprecation in v0.50.0, the underscore-vs-hyphen note in [28] and the two-qubit Pauli-Lindblad restriction in [38]. The prose uses formal 합니다체 almost everywhere (안내합니다, 만들어졌습니다, 작동합니다) and only switches to 해요체 in the imperatives (하세요), so it breaks the project's 해요체 convention. "Directed execution model" is left in English in [7] but rendered 지시된 실행 모델 in [43]. The title in [0] also has a stiff stacked calque ("헬퍼 프로그램 사용에서 … 마이그레이션").

examples.source: [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model)
examples.translation: [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model)과 호환되는
examples.suggested: [지시된 실행 모델](/guides/directed-execution-model)과 호환되는
examples.why: Entry [43] translates the same link text as 지시된 실행 모델, so the term is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: The NoiseLearner class was created to allow users to perform explicit noise learning.
examples.translation: 클래스는 사용자가 명시적인 노이즈 학습을 수행할 수 있도록 만들어졌습니다.
examples.suggested: 클래스는 사용자가 명시적으로 노이즈 학습을 수행할 수 있도록 만들어졌어요.
examples.why: Declaratives are in formal 합니다체 across the whole page, while the project convention is 해요체.

examples.source: Migrate from using the NoiseLearner helper program to NoiseLearnerV3 in IBM Quantum Compute Service
examples.translation: IBM Quantum Compute Service에서 NoiseLearner 헬퍼 프로그램 사용에서 NoiseLearnerV3로 마이그레이션
examples.suggested: IBM Quantum Compute Service에서 NoiseLearner 헬퍼 프로그램을 NoiseLearnerV3로 마이그레이션하기
examples.why: Two stacked '에서' phrases copy the English structure and read awkwardly.

editor_note: The four rewritten entries match the English: entry 4 keeps the source's odd wording ('정밀도가 낮을수록 … 더 많은 샷이 필요'), and entry 7 keeps the staleness caveat ('일정 시간이 지나면 유효하지 않게 되므로 … 세션 내에서').

The meaning is faithful throughout. The QAOA description, the one-round grid-search caveat, the benchmark disclaimer and the binary-to-spin mapping all match the source, and no claims are inverted or invented. The problem names are inconsistent: the body uses 마켓 스플릿 and 셰링턴-커크패트릭, but the Next-steps admonition [62] leaves them as "Market Split" and "Sherrington-Kirkpatrick". The prose uses 합니다체 throughout rather than the project's 해요체. Several phrases are calqued from English: "첫 번째 안정적인 프로덕션 버전을 기록합니다" ("marks"), "추가 최적화 알고리즘, 및" (English serial "and"), "크게 최소화합니다", "결과를 검색합니다" ("retrieve"), and "솔루션 문자열을 무작위로 반복하며".

examples.source: Try the tutorial for applying the Parity Twine Optimizer to the Market Split problem.
examples.translation: Market Split 문제에 Parity Twine Optimizer를 적용하는 [튜토리얼]을 시도해 보세요.
examples.suggested: 마켓 스플릿 문제에 Parity Twine Optimizer를 적용하는 [튜토리얼]을 따라 해 보세요.
examples.why: Entries [24]/[29]/[58] render the name as 마켓 스플릿 (and 셰링턴-커크패트릭), but here it is left in English, so the file is inconsistent.

examples.source: This release marks the first stable production version ... additional optimization algorithms, and
examples.translation: 이 릴리스는 ... 첫 번째 안정적인 프로덕션 버전을 기록합니다. ... - 추가 최적화 알고리즘, 및
examples.suggested: 이번 릴리스는 ... 첫 번째 안정 프로덕션 버전이에요. ... - 추가 최적화 알고리즘
examples.why: 'marks' is calqued as 기록합니다, and the English list-final 'and' is carried over as a dangling 및.

examples.source: a local greedy search that iterates randomly through the solution string and flips bit values
examples.translation: 솔루션 문자열을 무작위로 반복하며 ... 비트 값을 뒤집는 로컬 그리디 검색
examples.suggested: 솔루션 문자열의 비트를 무작위 순서로 훑으면서 ... 비트 값을 뒤집는 로컬 그리디 탐색
examples.why: '무작위로 반복하며' is a literal rendering of 'iterates'. It reads as repeating randomly rather than visiting bits in random order.

examples.source: Retrieve results as follows:
examples.translation: 다음과 같이 결과를 검색합니다:
examples.suggested: 다음과 같이 결과를 가져와요:
examples.why: 'Retrieve' here means fetching the results, not searching for them. 검색 means search.

examples.source: This greatly minimizes the required QPU runtime of the optimizer.
examples.translation: 이는 최적화기에 필요한 QPU 런타임을 크게 최소화합니다.
examples.suggested: 덕분에 최적화기에 필요한 QPU 실행 시간이 크게 줄어들어요.
examples.why: '크게 최소화' is a calque. The whole file also uses 합니다체 instead of the project's 해요체 convention.

editor_note: Entries 64 and 65 render "Review the ... API" faithfully as "[`qiskit-ibm-runtime` Estimator/Sampler](...) API를 검토하세요". They keep the links and markup intact and match the 해요체 imperative used in the sibling entries 61 and 62.

I reviewed only the two rewritten entries. Neither misleads a learner, but each has a small slip a native editor would fix. In [27], the English apposition "The IBM Quantum primitives, EstimatorV2 and SamplerV2" became a bare comma list, "IBM Quantum 프리미티브, EstimatorV2와 SamplerV2는". That can read as three separate items, so "IBM Quantum 프리미티브인 EstimatorV2와 SamplerV2는" would be clearer. In [34], the hedge "you might be able to more easily access" was flattened to the definite "더 쉽게 접근할 수 있습니다", which drops the qualifier. The terms are otherwise faithful and consistent: 오류 완화 및 억제 for error mitigation and suppression, and 프리미티브 for primitive.

examples.source: The IBM Quantum primitives, EstimatorV2 and SamplerV2, provide a more sophisticated implementation
examples.translation: IBM Quantum 프리미티브, EstimatorV2와 SamplerV2는 클라우드 기반 서비스로 더욱 정교한 구현(예: 오류 완화 포함)을 제공합니다.
examples.suggested: IBM Quantum 프리미티브인 EstimatorV2와 SamplerV2는 클라우드 기반 서비스로서 더 정교한 구현(예: 오류 완화 포함)을 제공합니다.
examples.why: A Korean reader can take the comma as a list of three items instead of an apposition. Adding 인 makes it clear that EstimatorV2 and SamplerV2 are the IBM Quantum primitives.

examples.source: you might be able to more easily access advanced hardware capabilities of a given provider
examples.translation: 특정 제공업체의 고급 하드웨어 기능에 더 쉽게 접근할 수 있습니다
examples.suggested: 특정 제공업체의 고급 하드웨어 기능에 더 쉽게 접근할 수도 있습니다
examples.why: The hedge 'might' is dropped, which makes the claim slightly stronger. Changing 수 있습니다 to 수도 있습니다 keeps the original caution.

editor_note: None of the four rewritten entries (61, 78, 96, 97) changes the meaning. The T2/Hahn echo definition, the lowest-error-over-six-100-qubit-chains logic and the init_error vs prob_meas1_prep0 caveat are all accurate. Entry 97 breaks the file's conventions. It renders Calibration data as '보정 데이터' where the rest of the page uses '교정 데이터', and its 'Qiskit로 확인' has the wrong particle (it should be 'Qiskit으로') and does not match the '…으로 보기' headers used everywhere else. Entry 78 leaves 'Details 섹션' and the section name 'Two-qubit gate error (layered)' in English, and calls the card '세부 정보 카드', while the rest of the file uses '세부 정보 섹션', '2Qubit Gate 오류 (레이어드) 섹션' and '상세 정보 카드'.

examples.source: Calibration data section: Qubit dropdown menu
examples.translation: 보정 데이터 섹션: qubit 드롭다운 메뉴
examples.suggested: 교정 데이터 섹션: qubit 드롭다운 메뉴
examples.why: Every other table on the page uses 교정 데이터 for the same UI section, so the learner sees two names for one section.

examples.source: View with Qiskit / View on IBM Quantum Platform
examples.translation: Qiskit로 확인 / IBM Quantum Platform에서 확인
examples.suggested: Qiskit으로 보기 / IBM Quantum Platform에서 보기
examples.why: The particle after Qiskit (ends in a consonant) should be 으로, and every other table in the file uses '…으로 보기' for these row headers.

examples.source: The final value, at chain length 100, is the value presented in the Details section.
examples.translation: 체인 길이 100에서의 최종 값이 Details 섹션에 표시되는 값입니다.
examples.suggested: 체인 길이 100에서의 최종 값이 세부 정보 섹션에 표시되는 값입니다.
examples.why: The rest of the file translates the Details section as 세부 정보 섹션. The same entry also leaves the section name 'Two-qubit gate error (layered)' in English, while entry 79 calls it 2Qubit Gate 오류 (레이어드).

examples.source: the detailed information card for each QPU
examples.translation: 각 QPU의 세부 정보 카드
examples.suggested: 각 QPU의 상세 정보 카드
examples.why: Elsewhere the page calls this card 상세 정보 카드 and keeps 세부 정보 for the Details section. Using 세부 정보 for both blurs the card and its section.

editor_note: The five rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: entry 7 keeps the `enabled` restriction and the "동일한 리소스에 액세스할 수 있더라도 서로를 볼 수 없습니다" caveat, entry 21 keeps the "최소 권한 집합" meaning, and in entries 33–34 the region labels ("us-east 지역", "eu-de 지역") are correct.

All 9 rewritten entries match their English: entry 21 keeps the twirling condition and the product of `num_randomizations` and `shots_per_randomization` ("…의 곱이 사용됩니다"), "API documentation" is rendered as "API 문서" in every link entry, and entry 58's "각 shot마다 큐비트를 기저 상태로 초기화할지 여부" is accurate.

Neither rewritten entry changes the meaning. Entry 31 keeps every point of the English: the wrapper registers jobs and sessions with the parent Serverless job, the platform uses that link for status tracking, logs, usage and accounting, and the link is lost with a bare QiskitRuntimeService ("절대 연결하지 않으므로 이 연결 관계가 사라집니다"). The one issue is a style slip in entry 7, where one sentence uses 활용 twice ("`qiskit-ibm-catalog`를 활용하여 … 원격 서비스로 활용하는"). A native editor would change one of them.

examples.source: and then implement `qiskit-ibm-catalog` to upload your program to IBM Quantum Platform to use as a reusable remote service.
examples.translation: `qiskit-ibm-catalog`를 활용하여 프로그램을 IBM Quantum Platform에 업로드함으로써 재사용 가능한 원격 서비스로 활용하는 방법을 설명합니다.
examples.suggested: `qiskit-ibm-catalog`로 프로그램을 IBM Quantum Platform에 업로드하여 재사용 가능한 원격 서비스로 활용하는 방법을 설명합니다.
examples.why: The sentence uses 활용 twice, and 업로드함으로써 is stiff. Changing the first 활용하여 to 로 or 사용하여 reads more naturally without changing the meaning.

editor_note: The meaning of rewritten entry 37 is correct and will not mislead a learner. The problem is that the heading half-translates the product name as "IBM Quantum 컴퓨팅 서비스", but the section's own body keeps the official English name "IBM Quantum Compute Service" in entries 40 and 44. Neighbouring headings also keep proper names in English ("IBM Quantum System API" in [22], "Pasqal Cloud Services" in [46]). The heading should use the English product name so it matches the text below it and the other headings.

examples.source: IBM Quantum Compute Service {#ibm-quantum-compute-service}
examples.translation: IBM Quantum 컴퓨팅 서비스 {#ibm-quantum-compute-service}
examples.suggested: IBM Quantum Compute Service {#ibm-quantum-compute-service}
examples.why: This is a product name. The body of the same section keeps it in English ([40] 'IBM Quantum Compute Service 인스턴스', [44] 'IBM Quantum Compute Service가'), and so do the sibling headings [22] and [46]. Half-translating it in the heading makes it inconsistent with the rest of the page.

editor_note: Entry 29 is faithful clause by clause. It keeps "IBM이 승인하고 미국에 소재한 제3자 데이터 처리자", the three shared data items (이름, 이메일 주소, 획득한 배지), the hedge "공유할 수 있습니다" for "may share", and both privacy-statement links, and "귀하" fits a legal notice.

Entries 5 and 6 say the same thing as the English: "compound system" becomes 복합 시스템, "some but not all" becomes 일부만 측정, and entanglement becomes 얽힘, "a type of correlation" (상관관계의 일종). Splitting "to which the previous lesson applies" into its own sentence (그러면 이전 레슨의 논의를 그대로 적용할 수 있습니다) is natural and loses nothing; the 합니다체 register matches the rest of the page.

Entry 4 keeps the meaning. "결코 감수할 수 없는 위험" correctly carries "certainly can't risk" decoding and re-encoding, and "보호를 결코 벗어나지 않는 *논리* Qubit" matches "never go without the protection". Entry 9 is also accurate, but it leaves the link text "[YouTube video]" in English while the same sentence group translates the other link, "[슬라이드를 내려받을]". A Korean editor would change it to "YouTube 영상". Neither entry would mislead a learner.

examples.source: you can open the [YouTube video](...) for this lesson in a separate window
examples.translation: 이 레슨의 [YouTube video](...)를 별도의 창에서 열 수도 있습니다.
examples.suggested: 이 레슨의 [YouTube 영상](...)을 별도의 창에서 열 수도 있습니다.
examples.why: The link text was left in English, but the slides link in the same entry was translated. It reads as unfinished, and the particle after 'video' is awkward.

editor_note: All four rewritten entries match their English and read naturally in Korean: [19] keeps t as an unspecified parameter ("지정되지 않으며"), [20] gets the order of steps and "$t$번 적용" right, and [32] carries "possibly with a different choice" as "(경우에 따라 다른 $t$ 값을 선택해)".

I judged only the rewritten entry [6]. Its meaning is faithful and nothing in it would mislead a learner. The FFT and sorting comparison keeps "slightly less than a quadratic advantage" as "이차보다 약간 작은 이점". The caveat that the technology is still early is kept. The last sentence is split in two, but it is still a possibility ("이어질 수도 있습니다"), not a firmer claim. A native editor would still smooth a few calqued phrases: "그들이 해결하는 문제" copies the English pronoun, and "양자가 고전 컴퓨팅에 대해 제공하는 이차적 이점" is stiff where "고전 컴퓨팅 대비 양자의 이차적 이점" reads naturally. The split also loosens the English link that technological progress is what makes the benefit possible, and the "very much" in "very much in its infancy" is dropped.

examples.source: to one day offer tangible practical benefits
examples.translation: 기술 발전의 잠재력을 성급하게 과소평가해서는 안 됩니다. 언젠가는 양자가 고전 컴퓨팅에 대해 제공하는 이차적 이점이 실질적인 이득으로 이어질 수도 있습니다.
examples.suggested: 언젠가 고전 컴퓨팅 대비 양자의 이차적 이점이 실질적인 이득으로 이어지게 할 수도 있는 기술 발전의 잠재력을 성급하게 과소평가해서는 안 됩니다.
examples.why: '양자가 ... 에 대해 제공하는' is a stiff calque. Splitting the sentence also weakens the English link that technological progress is what enables the benefit.

examples.source: over naive approaches to the problems they solve
examples.translation: 그들이 해결하는 문제에 대한 단순한(나이브한) 접근 방식에 비해
examples.suggested: 해당 문제를 푸는 단순한(나이브한) 접근 방식에 비해
examples.why: '그들이' copies the English pronoun 'they', which Korean technical prose would leave out.

examples.source: still very much in its infancy
examples.translation: 아직 초기 단계에 있지만
examples.suggested: 아직 걸음마 단계에 불과하지만
examples.why: The emphasis of 'very much' is lost, which slightly softens the caveat. This is minor.

editor_note: The three rewritten entries (3, 5, 7) are faithful and read naturally. Entry 3 keeps the scope 'physically realizable (in an idealized sense)' in '(이상화된 의미에서) 물리적으로 실현 가능한 것은 채널로 기술할 수 있습니다', and 채널/사상/이산 시간 are used consistently. Entry 5 renders 'equivalent mathematical characterizations' as '동등한 수학적 특성화', which is correct.

None of the 21 rewritten entries changes the meaning in a way that would mislead a learner. The depth claim in [75] ("80 이상이더라도 고충실도 결과") and the caveats about allocation and control in [120] are both kept accurately. The remaining problems are small. [134] switches to 하십시오체 ("무엇입니까?", "있습니까, 없습니까?") where the page otherwise uses 해요체. [148] calls the next lesson "다음 강의", but [75] uses "다음 레슨". [147] uses "이종 환경" for "heterogeneous", while [6] uses "이기종". [119] leaves out the informal "we will cheat a bit".

examples.source: what is (a) the name of the job ... (d) Finally, could this use quantum resources or not?
examples.translation: (a) 작업의 이름, (b) Python 파일의 이름, (c) 출력 파일의 이름은 무엇입니까? (d) 마지막으로, 이것이 양자 리소스를 사용할 수 있습니까, 없습니까?
examples.suggested: ...출력 파일의 이름은 무엇인가요? (d) 마지막으로, 이 스크립트는 양자 리소스를 사용할 수 있을까요, 없을까요?
examples.why: This is formal 하십시오체 on a page that otherwise uses 해요체, and the exercise in [69] is phrased with 해요체 ('무엇인가요?').

examples.source: In the following lesson, we will build on this knowledge...
examples.translation: 다음 강의에서는 이 리소스 제어에 대한 지식을 바탕으로...
examples.suggested: 다음 레슨에서는 이 리소스 제어에 대한 지식을 바탕으로...
examples.why: 'lesson' is rendered '레슨' in [0] and [75] ('다음 레슨에서 더 자세히 다룹니다'). This is a within-file inconsistency.

examples.source: how to use them to run programs in heterogeneous environments
examples.translation: 이를 이종 환경에서 프로그램을 실행하는 데 어떻게 활용하는지
examples.suggested: 이를 이기종 환경에서 프로그램을 실행하는 데 어떻게 활용하는지
examples.why: The same page uses '이기종 HPC 환경' for 'heterogeneous' in [6]. '이기종' is the usual computing term.

examples.source: we will cheat a bit and provide you a repository with Docker images that are mimicking an actual HPC cluster
examples.translation: Docker 이미지가 담긴 저장소를 제공하여 소규모이지만 실제 Slurm HPC 클러스터를 모사하는 환경을 구성했습니다
examples.suggested: 약간 편법을 써서, 소규모이지만 실제 Slurm HPC 클러스터를 모사하는 Docker 이미지가 담긴 저장소를 제공합니다
examples.why: The translation drops the informal 'cheat a bit', which tells the learner that this setup is only a stand-in for a real cluster. The meaning is otherwise intact.

editor_note: Neither rewritten entry would mislead a learner. Entry 5 is faithful and in 해요체 (축하해요, 고마워요), and entry 12 keeps every clause of the Credly privacy notice: data shared, US location, sharing with subsidiaries and third parties worldwide, and IBM privacy practices. The one slip is in entry 12. "IBM 디지털 배지를 발급하려면 … Credly에 공유됩니다" uses -려면, which reads as the learner's own wish ("if you want to issue a badge"). It should state IBM's purpose instead, for example "발급하기 위해". Using 귀하 and 합니다체 in this legal notice is a defensible exception to 해요체 and is not flagged.

examples.source: In order to issue you an IBM Digital Badge, your personal information (name, email address, and badge earned) will be shared with Credly.
examples.translation: IBM 디지털 배지를 발급하려면 귀하의 개인 정보(이름, 이메일 주소, 획득한 배지)가 Credly에 공유됩니다.
examples.suggested: IBM 디지털 배지를 발급하기 위해 귀하의 개인 정보(이름, 이메일 주소, 획득한 배지)가 Credly에 공유됩니다.
examples.why: -려면 frames the clause as the reader's own intention or condition and leaves the subject unclear. The English states IBM's purpose, which 위해 expresses naturally.

editor_note: None of the 5 rewritten entries (9, 39, 49, 55, 58) misleads a reader. The years, qubit counts (1,121 / 1,386+ / 4,000, 133→156) and Heron-vs-Eagle claims all match the English, and "inches of progress"→"한 뼘씩" reads naturally. Three small slips need an edit. In entry 49, "the largest to date" loses "to date" (현재까지), so Osprey reads as the largest superconducting processor without a time limit. In entry 58, "enabling technologies" becomes "핵심 기술" ("core technologies"), and "organizational skill set" becomes the calque "조직의 역량 집합". Entry 55 also mixes "133 Qubit" with "2큐비트 및 단일 큐비트" in one sentence; the separate leak sweep should fix that.

examples.source: 433-qubit IBM Quantum Osprey processor — the largest to date using superconducting qubits
examples.translation: 초전도 Qubit을 사용하는 최대 규모인 433-Qubit IBM Quantum Osprey 프로세서
examples.suggested: 당시까지 초전도 큐비트를 사용한 프로세서 중 최대 규모인 433큐비트 IBM Quantum Osprey 프로세서
examples.why: The dropped 'to date' makes the claim timeless. Larger IBM processors came out later (for example the 1,121-qubit one the same table mentions for 2023).

examples.source: adoption of enabling technologies such as automation, AI, and hybrid multi-cloud
examples.translation: 자동화, AI, 하이브리드 멀티클라우드와 같은 핵심 기술의 도입
examples.suggested: 자동화, AI, 하이브리드 멀티클라우드와 같은 기반(지원) 기술의 도입
examples.why: 'Enabling' means technologies that make something possible (기반/지원 기술). 'Core' (핵심) is a slightly different claim.

examples.source: and organizational skill set
examples.translation: 그리고 조직의 역량 집합이 포함됩니다
examples.suggested: 그리고 조직의 역량이 포함됩니다
examples.why: '역량 집합' is a word-for-word calque of 'skill set'. A Korean business writer would just write '조직 역량'.

editor_note: None of the five rewritten entries (10, 13, 26, 28, 33) would mislead a learner. The meaning, caveats and quantities all match the English (20 parameters, a 20-dimensional search, keeping depth "as low as is reasonable"), and 해요체 is used throughout. A native editor would still fix three things. In entry 13, 즉 turns the illustrative "say rx and y" into "namely". Entry 28 calls the `full` scheme 전체 얽힘 방식, while entry 17 names the same scheme Full 얽힘 방식. In entry 33, the second clause of the parameter-update sentence has lost its subject: the parameters are said to be chosen and then to update the parameters themselves.

examples.source: with two types of SU(2) gates, say `rx` and `y`
examples.translation: 두 가지 유형의 SU(2) gate, 즉 `rx`와 `y`를 사용하는
examples.suggested: 두 가지 유형의 SU(2) gate(예: `rx`와 `y`)를 사용하는
examples.why: 'say' here means 'for example'. 즉 ('namely') makes the two gates sound like the only fixed choice instead of an illustration.

examples.source: You might have a target state that requires a full entanglement scheme.
examples.translation: 전체 얽힘 방식을 필요로 하는 목표 상태가 있을 수 있습니다.
examples.suggested: full 얽힘 방식이 필요한 목표 상태도 있을 수 있어요.
examples.why: Entry 17 names this Qiskit scheme 'Full 얽힘 방식'. Using 전체 얽힘 here loses the link to the named `full` option.

examples.source: Those parameters are chosen by making successive guesses, and updating parameters to lower the expectation value of the cost function
examples.translation: 이러한 매개변수는 연속적인 추측을 통해 선택되고, 비용 함수(...)의 기댓값을 낮추도록 매개변수를 업데이트합니다.
examples.suggested: 이러한 매개변수는 추측을 거듭하면서, 비용 함수(...)의 기댓값이 낮아지도록 매개변수를 갱신하는 방식으로 정해집니다.
examples.why: The second clause has no subject of its own and borrows '매개변수는', so the parameters appear to update themselves. This is a calque of the English participle structure.

editor_note: Rewritten heading [3] "고전 옵티마이저" is faithful and matches the page's consistent rendering of "classical optimizer(s)" as 고전 옵티마이저 in entries [5], [10], [12] and [17].

I checked all four rewritten entries (5, 7, 8, 12) against the English and found no meaning errors. The exam has 20 questions with a pass mark of 16, the badge goes to the IBM Training email, and the Credly notice keeps every data item and purpose, including "may share with subsidiaries and third parties globally". The only problem is register. Entries 7 and 8 use formal 하십시오체 with an honorific ("클릭하시면 … 응시할 수 있습니다", "맞혀야 합니다", "전송됩니다") instead of the project's 해요체. Entry 5 mixes "축하해요" with "사용됩니다". The Credly legal notice in entry 12 is also in formal style, but that is defensible for legal boilerplate.

examples.source: click the button below to navigate to IBM® Training, where you can take the badging exam
examples.translation: 아래 버튼을 클릭하시면 IBM® Training으로 이동하며, 그곳에서 VQE를 사용한 양자 화학 배지 시험에 응시할 수 있습니다.
examples.suggested: 아래 버튼을 클릭하면 IBM® Training으로 이동해요. 그곳에서 VQE를 사용한 양자 화학 배지 시험에 응시할 수 있어요.
examples.why: The honorific 하시면 and the formal 습니다 ending break the 해요체 convention. The meaning is correct.

examples.source: you must answer at least 16 correctly to pass ... your badge will automatically be sent
examples.translation: 합격하려면 최소 16문제를 정답으로 맞혀야 합니다. ... 배지가 자동으로 전송됩니다.
examples.suggested: 합격하려면 최소 16문제를 맞혀야 해요. ... 배지가 자동으로 전송돼요.
examples.why: This is a formal 합니다체 slip, and 정답으로 맞히다 is slightly redundant. The numbers and condition are faithful.

editor_note: None of the 11 rewritten entries misleads the reader. Entry 8's error suppression and mitigation, entry 12's heavy-hex topology, and entry 69's contrast between suppression and mitigation all keep their meaning. The same term is spelled two ways in neighbouring entries: entry 69 writes '파울리 트월링(Pauli twirling)' and entry 71 writes 'Pauli 트월링'. There are also two calques a native editor would change: entry 42's 'can largely be abstracted away from the user' became '대부분 사용자로부터 추상화될 수 있습니다', and entry 46 uses the unnatural collocation '양자 컴퓨터의 이점을 받기 어렵습니다'.

examples.source: Pauli twirling is a way of inserting random gates...
examples.translation: Pauli 트월링은 동적 디커플링처럼 ...
examples.suggested: 파울리 트월링은 동적 디커플링처럼 ...
examples.why: Entry 69 (also rewritten) uses '파울리 트월링'. Pick one spelling for the term across the section.

examples.source: which can largely be abstracted away from the user
examples.translation: 이는 대부분 사용자로부터 추상화될 수 있습니다
examples.suggested: 이러한 기법은 대부분 추상화되어 있어 사용자가 직접 다룰 필요가 거의 없습니다
examples.why: '사용자로부터 추상화되다' copies the English passive structure word for word. The suggested wording says the same thing in the way a Korean technical writer would.

examples.source: Tasks that are easy for classical computers probably won't benefit from a quantum computer.
examples.translation: 고전 컴퓨터에 쉬운 작업은 양자 컴퓨터의 이점을 받기 어렵습니다.
examples.suggested: 고전 컴퓨터로 쉽게 풀리는 작업은 양자 컴퓨터를 써도 얻는 이점이 거의 없을 것입니다.
examples.why: '이점을 받다' is not a natural collocation in Korean. '이점을 얻다' or '이점이 있다' is standard.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the DD refocusing derivation, the coherent vs. incoherent accumulation argument and the GHZ explanation of why twirling can hurt. Nothing would mislead a learner. From [150] on, the last part of the file reads like a separate translation pass. 'Pauli twirling' changes from 파울리 트윌링 to 파울리 트월링, 'dynamical decoupling' from 동적 분리 to 동적 디커플링 in [154], 'two-qubit' from 이중 큐비트 to 2큐비트, 'coherent' from 결맞은 to 결맞는, and 'lesson' from 강의 to 레슨. The whole page uses 합니다체 with 하십시오 imperatives (확인해 보십시오, 주목하십시오, 예상하십니까) instead of the 해요체 convention. There are also a few small drifts and calques: [128] joins swap gates and circuit depth with 즉 ('that is') where the English says 'thus'; [154] 없어야 합니다 turns an expectation into an obligation; and [161] renders 'At the high end' as 상단에서는.

examples.source: Pauli twirling fundamentally changes this situation.
examples.translation: 파울리 트월링은 이 상황을 근본적으로 바꿉니다.
examples.suggested: 파울리 트윌링은 이 상황을 근본적으로 바꿔요.
examples.why: Entries [5]–[121] use 트윌링. From here to the end the file switches to 트월링, and 결맞은 also becomes 결맞는.

examples.source: firstly there should not be any extremely long idle periods in this circuit.
examples.translation: 첫째, 이 회로에는 극도로 긴 유휴 기간이 없어야 합니다.
examples.suggested: 첫째, 이 회로에는 극도로 긴 유휴 구간이 없을 거예요.
examples.why: The English states an expectation. 없어야 합니다 reads as a requirement. The same entry also uses 동적 디커플링 where the rest of the file uses 동적 분리.

examples.source: the qubits were selected in a chain to minimize swap gates and thus circuit depth.
examples.translation: 큐비트들이 스왑 게이트, 즉 회로 깊이를 최소화하기 위해 체인 형태로 선택되었음을 알 수 있습니다.
examples.suggested: 스왑 게이트를 줄이고 그에 따라 회로 깊이도 최소화하도록 큐비트가 체인 형태로 선택되었음을 알 수 있어요.
examples.why: 즉 ('that is') makes swap gates and circuit depth sound like the same thing. The English means that fewer swaps lead to lower depth.

examples.source: At the high end, some of these are quite deep.
examples.translation: 상단에서는 이러한 회로 중 일부가 상당히 깊습니다.
examples.suggested: 레이어 수가 많은 쪽에서는 일부 회로가 상당히 깊어요.
examples.why: 상단 is a literal calque. The English means circuits with many layers.

examples.source: and pay attention to the type of DD sequence being used.
examples.translation: 사용하는 DD 시퀀스의 유형에 주의를 기울이십시오.
examples.suggested: 사용하는 DD 시퀀스의 유형에도 주의를 기울이세요.
examples.why: The page uses 하십시오체/합니다체 throughout instead of the project's 해요체 convention (also [5] 유념하시기 바랍니다, [71] 예상하십니까).

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (5, 7, 12) would mislead a learner. They keep the source's conditions, the exam order (read the lessons first, then take the exam) and every privacy caveat, including sharing with IBM subsidiaries and third parties worldwide. The one fix is in entry 12, where "claiming the badge" is rendered 배지를 청구하는. 청구 reads like billing or a legal demand, and Credly's Korean UI and native writers would say 배지를 수령하는 (receiving the badge). Two choices are fine as they are: entry 5's 주피터 노트북, which only makes the notebook explicit, and the 합니다 register, which matches the rest of the page.

examples.source: You will receive an email notification from Credly with instructions for claiming the badge.
examples.translation: 배지를 청구하는 방법에 대한 안내가 담긴 이메일 알림을 Credly로부터 받게 됩니다.
examples.suggested: 배지 수령 방법이 안내된 이메일 알림을 Credly로부터 받게 됩니다.
examples.why: 청구 means billing or a legal demand. In Korean badge and credential contexts, "claim" is normally 수령 or 받기.

editor_note: None of the 8 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The hedges survive: 'might' in [47] is '수도 있습니다', 'under specific assumptions' in [63] is kept, and 'unlikely … replace' in [22] is '대체할 가능성은 낮습니다'. Two wording problems remain. In [22], 'already being used regularly' became '정기적으로 사용되고', which means 'on a fixed schedule' rather than 'routinely'. In [3], the opening sentence has no subject ('이 강좌를 … 시작했습니다'), so it reads as a calque.

examples.source: Error mitigation, on the other hand, is already being used regularly to improve quantum computing results.
examples.translation: 반면 오류 완화는 이미 양자 컴퓨팅 결과를 개선하기 위해 정기적으로 사용되고 있습니다.
examples.suggested: 반면 오류 완화는 이미 양자 컴퓨팅 결과를 개선하는 데 일상적으로 활용되고 있습니다.
examples.why: '정기적으로' means periodically or on a schedule. The English 'regularly' here means routinely or commonly, and '일상적으로' or '널리' is the natural rendering.

examples.source: You began this course by diving right into running your first quantum circuit ... In this section, we will explore ...
examples.translation: 이 강좌를 첫 번째 양자 Circuit을 직접 실행하고, ... 배우는 것으로 시작했습니다. ... 이 레슨에서는 ...
examples.suggested: 여러분은 첫 번째 양자 회로를 바로 실행해 보고 ... 배우면서 이 강좌를 시작했습니다. ... 이 섹션에서는 ...
examples.why: The object-first sentence has no subject, so it reads as a calque of English word order. 'Section' was also changed to '레슨', which is a slight change of scope but harmless.

editor_note: All six rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. The depth definition in [172] ("다중 qubit Gate로 연결된 경우에만 Qubit을 전환", "Gate의 최대 개수가 바로 깊이") and the ideal-versus-real-device caveat in [183] ("qubit 연결성과 같은 실제 장치의 제약") keep the English meaning intact, and "확률 진폭"/"보른 규칙" in [94] are the correct terms.
Entry 82 is faithful and natural: "error suppression options" renders as 오류 억제 옵션, which matches the entry 81 heading, and "Sampler 노이즈 관리" agrees with 노이즈 in entry 26; the sentence uses 해요체 (참고하세요).
